jobs.occupation: PhD fellowship in Veterinary Virology
jobs.description:
Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences University of Copenhagen     We are offering a PhD fellowship in Veterinary Virology commencing 1st of February 2027.  Our group and research Forskningsgruppen udfører forskning og undervisning inden for områderne enzootiske og zoonotiske virusinfektioner hos dyr. Forskningen vil de kommende år fokuseres på influenza infektioner i dyr, med fokus på zoonotiske aspekter af svine influenza virus. Gruppen bestå pt af ca. 20 forskere, phd studerende, studentermedhjælpere og 2 andre labornater. Vi har altid meget travlt, men har et godt arbejdsmiljø med masser af humor, kageklub og fleksible arbejdsopgaver og hvor alle hjælper alle.   The research group for Veterinary and Zoonotic Virology consists of around 20 members and as the name states work on both veterinary and zootonic viruses with a main focus on swine influenza A virus. We utilize different molecular methods such viral isolation in cells, qPCR/PCR, sequencing, ELISA and different immunological assays. The research group is very social and we have journal club, cake and breakfast club and Friday bars etc.   Project description The PhD project will be on cross-reactive vaccines for swine influenza A virus. The first part of the project will be focussed on establishing immunological assays in the laboratory and generating hyperimmune serum in pigs experimentally for following antigenic characterization of Danish swine influenza A virus. The second part of the PhD will be on selecting representative vaccine strains testing them first experimentally in pigs and afterwards in the field.  Principal supervisor is Professor Lars Erik Larsen, Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, lael@sund.ku.dk, phone:  +4540998434  Start:                  1 February 2027   Duration:          3 years as a PhD student  Job description Your key tasks as a PhD student at SUND are:   	
• Carrying through an independent research project under supervision.    	
• Completing PhD courses or other equivalent education corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS points. 	
• Participating in active research environments including a stay at another research team. 	
• Obtaining experience with teaching or other types of dissemination related to your PhD project 	
• Teaching and disseminating your knowledge. 	
• Writing a PhD thesis on the grounds of your project   PhD Programme Description: The PhD programme is a three-year full-time research education within the framework of the 5+3 scheme, intended for candidates holding a relevant academic degree within the project’s subject area (e.g., [relevant degrees]).  Qualifications: If you have completed your academic education in Denmark, the admission to the PhD programme requires a relevant Master’s degree (equivalent to 180 ECTS BSc + 120 ECTS MSc).  If you have an academic education from abroad, you must have either a degree equivalent to a Danish master's degree (180 ETCS + 120 ECTS MSc), or at a minimum, a bachelor’s degree equivalent to a Danish bachelor's degree (180 ECTS) and be academically qualified at master's level.  As part of the assessment of whether you meet the educational requirements, you must also achieve a positive academic evaluation and be assessed as the best qualified for the position.  Other important criteria are:   	
• The grade point average achieved 	
• Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project 	
• Previous publications 	
• Relevant work experience 	
• Other professional activities 	
• A curious mind-set with a strong interest in veterinary virology 	
• Language skills   Place of employment The place of employment is at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and the project will be carried out in collaboration with Statens Serum Institute, Landbrug og Fødevarer and Ceva Animal Health.  Terms of employment  The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.  The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 3 years. The start date is 1st of February 2027 or after agreement.  The employment is conditioned upon the applicant’s successful enrolment as a PhD student at the Graduate School at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant.  The PhD study must be completed in accordance with The Ministerial Order on the PhD programme (2013) and the Faculty’s rules on achieving the degree.   Salary, pension and terms of employment are in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Depending on seniority, the monthly salary starts at approximately 27,800 DKK/Roughly 3,700 EUR (October 2021 level) plus pension.  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).  Questions For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the principal supervisor.  General information about PhD studies at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences is available at the Graduate School’s website: https://healthsciences.ku.dk/phd/guidelines/  Application procedure Your application must be submitted electronically by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. The application must include the following documents in PDF format:   1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page)  2. CV incl. education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position  3. Certified copy of original Master of Science diploma and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in other language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. As a prerequisite for a PhD fellowship employment, your master’s degree must be equivalent to a Danish master’s degree. We encourage you to read more in the assessment database: https://ufm.dk/en/education/recognition-and-transparency/find-assessments/assessment-database. Please note that we might ask you to obtain an assessment of your education performed by the Ministry of Higher Education and Science.  4. Publication list (if possible)  Application deadline:  [Wednesday 4 November 2026, 23.59pm CET   We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.  The further process  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor.  The assessor makes a non-prioritized assessment of the academic qualifications and experience with respect to the above-mentioned area of research, techniques, skills and other requirements listed in the advertisement.  Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.  You find information about the recruitment process at: http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/  The applicants will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.  The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Specialist  Reblade ApS — Careers
jobs.description:
Supply Chain Specialist

Mørke, Denmark

About Reblade:

Reblade is a Danish technology company founded in 2020, developing autonomous drone-

based robotic systems for leading edge repair of wind turbine blades.

We design, develop, manufacture and test our own technology, combining mechanical

engineering, electronics, software and robotics.

Our international team works in English, and we collaborate with major wind energy

operators, universities and technology partners across Europe.

We are strengthening our supply chain and purchasing capabilities.

About the position:

We are looking for a Supply Chain Specialist to take responsibility for purchasing, supplier

management, inventory coordination and procurement cost control.

You will work closely with our engineering, production and finance teams to ensure that

components and materials are available when needed, suppliers meet our requirements, and

purchasing costs remain under control.

The position combines operational purchasing with supplier development, cost analysis and

process improvement.

Key responsibilities:

Purchasing and supplier management

• Manage purchasing activities, including RFQs, purchase orders, order confirmations and delivery

follow-up.

• Identify, evaluate and qualify suppliers based on quality, cost, lead time and delivery performance.

• Negotiate prices, commercial terms and supplier agreements.

• Maintain supplier records, purchasing documentation and performance evaluations.

• Resolve supplier-related issues, including delivery delays, incorrect shipments and quality concerns.

Inventory and supply chain coordination

• Coordinate material requirements with engineering and production teams.

• Monitor stock levels, reorder points and material availability.

• Support purchasing planning for prototype development, testing and production activities.

• Identify supply chain risks and propose alternative suppliers or sourcing solutions.

Cost control and administration

• Maintain purchasing cost overviews, spending reports and supplier price comparisons.

• Monitor purchasing budgets and identify cost reduction opportunities.

• Coordinate invoice verification, purchase order matching and payment follow-up with finance.

• Support the development and implementation of purchasing procedures and supply chain processes.

Your profile:

Required qualifications

• Minimum 3 years of experience in purchasing, procurement or supply chain management.

• Experience working with suppliers, quotations, purchase orders and delivery coordination.

• Understanding of procurement cost control, supplier pricing and commercial negotiations.

• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

• Good analytical skills and proficiency in Excel or similar tools.

• Professional English communication skills, both written and spoken.

What we offer:

• A permanent, full-time position in a growing Danish technology company.

• Direct responsibility for purchasing and supplier management activities.

• The opportunity to establish and improve purchasing and supply chain processes.

• A workplace where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have a direct impact.

Application:

Send us your CV and a short introduction outlining your relevant experience.

Applications will be reviewed continuously, and interviews will be arranged with suitable

candidates.

Contact: Stine Alexander Westergaard saw@reblade.dk // Call me: +45 42411163

Workplace: Reblade ApS, Mørke, Denmark

Starting date: As soon as possible, by agreement.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Massage Therapist – AIRE Ancient Baths Copenhagen
jobs.description:
The role:

As a Massage Therapist in our Copenhagen team, your role is to ensure clients' well-being by performing relaxing and cosmetic treatments following our established protocols. You'll also maintain our relaxation spaces in top condition with all the necessary materials for a perfect AIRE experience.

Key responsibilities:Customer Experience:

• 
Deliver relaxing treatments, including body and facial treatments and exfoliations, following AIRE's protocols and techniques for each.

• 
Clearly communicate treatment details and product information to clients, following our provided manual and protocols.

• 
Keep an ample supply of necessary products for customer experiences, promptly reporting any shortages or low stock.

• 
Maintain consistency in couples' treatments and coordinate effectively with partner therapists for a seamless experience.

Workplace:

• 
Keep work areas clean and ready for customer experiences per company protocols.

• 
Supervise facility sanitation, product maintenance, and cleaning between treatments.

• 
Ensure environmental conditions meet protocol standards for noise, temperature, and humidity.

You'll receive thorough training to explore our diverse range of treatments and truly grasp the essence of AIRE's unique approach.

We're excited to welcome you to our team in Copenhagen and invite you to immerse yourself in the AIRE experience!

Who we are looking for:

• 
You have at least one year of experience in a similar role.

• 
You hold a valid Massage Therapist course or certification

• 
Fluent in English, and if you know Danish, that's a fantastic bonus! 

• 
You're genuinely customer-focused and excel at connecting with people

• 
Your schedule is flexible, allowing you to work evenings, holidays, and weekends when necessary

Why you should join us:

• 
Salary: Your hourly salary will be 182DKK

• 
Permanent Contract and Working Hours: You will have a permanent contract with 20 hours per week

• 
Working days: Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

• 
Supplement Pay: You will earn a supplement pay on weekends and holidays

• 
Additional Pay Opportunities: You can earn extra pay through tips.

• 
Career Progression: Explore career progression opportunities within our Therapists team: Senior Therapist, Supervisor, Manager

• 
Pension Contribution: AIRE will contribute to your pension scheme

• 
Referral Program: Get rewarded for referring potential colleagues

• 
Birthday Gift: Enjoy an AIRE experience on your birthday!

• 
Discounts: Benefit from 30% off on all our AIRE experiences

• 
Canteen Perks: Access to coffee at our canteen, and fruits on the weekends!

• 
Inclusive Work Environment: At AIRE, team spirit is our greatest asset! We are proud to have a welcoming and inclusive work environment where everyone's opinions and backgrounds are heard and respected. 

Copenhagen locationYou will be delighted with our place in Copenhagen, located in the Carlsberg Byen district, where the former Carlsberg factory has been given a new lease of life and now is part of the magical AIRE atmosphere.

About AIRE:

AIRE Ancient Baths offer a timeless relaxation experience, inspired by ancient Roman, Greek, and Ottoman traditions, set in restored historical buildings in major global cities.At AIRE, we're delighted to have a global presence with eight established centers in cities such as NYC, Chicago, London, Copenhagen, Barcelona, Sevilla, Almeria, and Vallromanes. Looking ahead, we're excited about our upcoming Upper East Side and Toronto facilities in 2024.

jobs.occupation: Lead Portfolio Manager to Support the Green Energy Transition
jobs.description:
Nordic RCC is a fast-developing company providing regional power system planning data and security analysis to support the national Transmission System Operators of Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark - to ensure the efficient operation of the Nordic Power System and high security of power supply at any time, with a vision of green transition.

Right now, we are looking for a Lead Portfolio Manager who likes making a difference!

Job description

As a Lead Portfolio Manager, you will join a team of skilled colleagues and contribute to Nordic RCC ambitious goals of green transition together with our owners in the 4 Nordic countries.

The Portfolio team is sitting in the PMO organization, together with Nordic Project Support team and the local project management team. You will report directly to the Head of PMO and have a close collaboration with the Senior Portfolio Manager and the local project management group, as well as the leadership team, Finance, and the manager of the Nordic Project Support team in PMO.

Responsibilities

Your tasks will include:

Portfolio management

• 
Drive continuous optimization of the Nordic RCC project portfolio with a focus on efficiency and strategic alignment.

• 
Lead financial budgeting and long-term planning in close collaboration with Finance.

• 
Deliver monthly portfolio reporting, including dependency tracking, to the leadership team and relevant stakeholders.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Coordination

• 
Foster collaboration between internal and external stakeholders to enhance efficiency and ensure continuous project execution.

• 
Act as the central point of contact for project-related inquiries from local project managers and teams.

• 
Maintain a comprehensive overview of project dependencies and support departments in addressing organizational challenges related to products, processes, and resources.

Governance & Best Practices

• 
Own and maintain the project Stage-Gate model, including governance structures and project management guidance.

• 
Ensure best practices are documented and prepare evidence for future audits.

• 
Drive continuous improvement by identifying inefficiencies, standardizing processes, and enhancing project governance within the PMO.

Tools & Processes

• 
Oversee portfolio and resource management processes and tools, ensuring they support strategic decision-making and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

• 
Hold a master’s degree in mathematics, economics, engineering, or a related field.

• 
Are proficient in English, both written and spoken. Additional languages are a plus.

• 
Exhibit strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions.

• 
Value teamwork and have a collaborative mindset.

• 
Respectful of agreements, deadlines, other people’s time and ideas, and listening to customer needs.

• 
Structured in your work and approach to tasks, working in an orderly manner.

• 
Strong interpersonal skills

• 
Advanced Excel skills

Requirements

• 
Have significant experience (more than 5-10 years) as a Project Portfolio Manager or similar within the European renewable energy sector.

• 
You bring a strong financial background and analytical mindset, enabling you to lead long-term planning and budgeting in close collaboration with Finance. Your financial insights make you a trusted advisor to the leadership team.

• 
You like to prepare management reports, presentations and follow up on activities.

• 
You like to gain and share knowledge/experience of various portfolio methods and processes.

• 
Have experience with both portfolio management and project management

• 
Knowledge of implementing IT solutions.

Employment conditions

You will join a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently more than 23 nationalities with more than 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We are offering workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance including the possibility for working from home some of your worktime. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined. 

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 15 November 2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

If any questions, please contact Head of PMO, Signe Uhre Guldfeldt by writing an email to sgu@nordic-rcc.net.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

jobs.description:
Experienced Milker Wanted for a Modern Jersey Dairy Farm in North Jutland
Would you like to be part of a workplace built on respect, teamwork, and professionalism?

A well-managed dairy farm near Vrå (9760) is looking for an experienced employee for milking and other barn-related tasks. The farm has been operated with great passion and professional expertise for more than 42 years and has built a strong workplace culture where employees support one another, show mutual respect, and share responsibility for the daily work.

The farm is home to approximately 900 Jersey cows and operates with modern facilities and well-established routines that ensure high animal welfare standards and a positive working environment.

About the Position

We are looking for a new team member to strengthen the workforce and help maintain the high standards of daily operations.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Milking in a modern 60-point rotary milking parlor
• Bedding cubicles
• Washing and cleaning
• General barn duties
Three employees are involved in the milking operation, and tasks are rotated according to a schedule, providing variety throughout the working week.

Working Hours

Milking takes place:

• 03:00 - 08:00
• 15:00 - 19:30
Weekend work is included according to a rotating schedule.

Typically, you will:

• Work both morning and afternoon milking shifts 1-2 times per week
• Work only one shift per day during the remaining weekdays
There is a shared morning coffee break at 08:00, where colleagues meet and coordinate the day's tasks.

Who Are You?

We expect that you:

• Have experience milking dairy cows
• Speak and understand English
• Have an interest in dairy farming and agriculture
• Thrive in a structured work environment with routines and responsibilities
• Are reliable and flexible
• Are friendly and team-oriented
• Take initiative and approach challenges with a solutions-focused mindset
A driver's license is not required.

We Offer

• Permanent employment with the possibility of many years of service
• Competitive salary based on qualifications
• A stable and professionally managed workplace with 42 years of experience
• An international working environment with both Danish and foreign colleagues
• Supportive colleagues who help one another
• A workplace where respect, cooperation, and professionalism are a natural part of everyday life
The team currently consists of approximately 20 employees, including colleagues from Denmark, Ukraine, Kyrgyzstan, and Eritrea.

Please contact Tetiana if you want more information. The job is as soon as possible.
